typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		SiteGroup as string,
		SiteName as string,
		DataHall as string,
		RackNlyteID as integer,
		RackName as string,
		WFGrid as string,
		AssetID as integer,
		AssetName as string,
		AssetNumber as integer,
		RFIDTag as string,
		AssetOperationalStatus as string,
		RecordModified as timestamp,
		RecordModifiedBy as string,
		MaterialName as string,
		CSOnlineStatus as string,
		CSDetectedLoc as string,
		PollType as string,
		FormattedIP as string,
		RealtimeTemp as decimal(18,3),
		RealtimeTempAverage as decimal(18,3),
		RealtimeTempMax as decimal(18,3),
		RealtimeTempMin as decimal(18,3),
		RealtimeLastUpdated as timestamp,
		CSDetectedLowBatt as string,
		TempType as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(IsBlankRow = iif((isNull(SiteGroup) || trim(SiteGroup) == ''), 1, 0)) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn split(IsBlankRow == 0,IsBlankRow == 1, disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Process,Ignore,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@Process sink(input(
		CSOnlineStatus as string,
		SiteName as string,
		TempType as string,
		WFGrid as string,
		SiteGroup as string,
		AssetNumber as integer,
		RealtimeTempAverage as integer,
		DataHall as string,
		RealtimeTempMax as integer,
		CSDetectedLowBatt as string,
		RFIDTag as string,
		MaterialName as string,
		AssetID as integer,
		CSDetectedLoc as string,
		RealtimeTempMin as integer,
		RecordModified as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		RackNlyteID as integer,
		AssetOperationalStatus as string,
		RecordModifiedBy as string,
		AssetName as string,
		PollType as string,
		RealtimeLastUpdated as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		RackName as string,
		FormattedIP as string,
		RealtimeTemp as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CSOnlineStatus,
		SiteName,
		TempType,
		WFGrid,
		SiteGroup,
		AssetNumber,
		RealtimeTempAverage,
		DataHall,
		RealtimeTempMax,
		CSDetectedLowBatt,
		RFIDTag,
		MaterialName,
		AssetID,
		CSDetectedLoc,
		RealtimeTempMin,
		RecordModified,
		RackNlyteID,
		AssetOperationalStatus,
		RecordModifiedBy,
		AssetName,
		PollType,
		RealtimeLastUpdated,
		RackName,
		FormattedIP,
		RealtimeTemp),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
